v4.6.108 — IBKR position gauges now show real entry & P/L

🎯 Fixed: on IBKR every position sat at 0% (break-even) on the position gauge, because each bot's slice stored only the share quantity — not what it paid. IBKR's account-level average cost comes back blended across all bots (and was often empty for cloud bots), so there was no true per-bot entry price.

Now each bot records its OWN average entry from its actual fills — gateway-independent and correct even when several bots hold the same stock. Existing positions are healed automatically by replaying the bot's fill history, so the gauge immediately shows the real entry → current → stop/target spread and live unrealized P/L.

Update via the in-app banner.
